"ReGroup and ReLoad"
Day:17 Thursday 10-17-24

Warm Up: Light KB Swings 5 sets of 10 reps
*75 sec rest between sets

1. BACK SQUAT "unbroken" 1 set of 10 reps @ 55%

2. FRONT SQUAT "unbroken" 1 set of 8 reps @ 35-40% of Back Squat max

3. BB Bulgarian Split Squats "unbroken"
1 set of 5 reps each leg
*90 sec rest between each exercise

4. DEADlift 4 reps @ 65%, 70%, 75%, 75%
*2 min rest between sets *No Bouncing

Cardio
super set
a. KB Swings 5 x 10 reps
b. DB Laterals 5 x 15 reps
*75 sec rest between each super set

Recovery
Meat Lover's Pizza
*Eat an extra Slice
30 min Walk
8-9 hrs Sleep

*This Strength session should take 30-35 minutes to complete.

"Day 17: ReGroup and ReLoad"
Warm up: Light KB Swings 5 sets of 10 reps
* 75 sec rest between sets
1. Back Squat 1 set of 10 reps @ 55%
* "Unbroken"
2. Front Squat 1 set of 8 reps @ 35-40% of back squat max
* "Unbroken"
3. Barbell Bulgarian Split Squats 1 set of 5 reps
* "Unbroken", each leg
* 90 sec rest between each exercise
4. Deadlift 4 reps @ 65%, 4 reps @ 70%, 4 reps @ 75%, 4 reps @ 75%
* No bouncing
rest 2:00
5. a. KB Swings 5 sets of 10 reps
super set b. DB Laterals 5 sets of 15 reps
rest 1:15 between each super set
Recovery: Meat Lover's Pizza · Eat an extra slice · 30 min walk · 8-9 hrs sleep
